assumptions: The filing entity is within the circular's defined licensed-firm categories.
The assessed event is an actual STR submission to the JFIU.
The event timestamp is interpreted in the timezone governing the circular's stated launch and blackout times.

citations.quote: licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”)
With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2.

children.distinction: This child isolates scope and launch timing from the unresolved e-Cert mechanics.

facts.meaning: The filing entity is a licensed firm within the circular's defined categories.
facts.name: is_licensed_firm

facts.meaning: The assessed event is an actual submission of an STR to the JFIU.
facts.name: is_str_submission_event

facts.meaning: The event occurred on or after the STREAMS 2 effective date.
facts.name: event_on_or_after_2026_02_02

questions: What evidence establishes the submitting entity's classification within the circular's licensed-firm categories?
What is the event timestamp, and which timezone governs the stated launch and blackout times?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] The scope and effective-date prerequisites are satisfied only when the submitting entity is an in-scope licensed firm, the event is an actual STR submission, and the event occurred on or after 2 February 2026.
children.subject: Licensed-firm scope and STREAMS 2 effective date

assumptions: The selected event used exactly one of the three listed STREAMS 2 submission means.
For XML or prescribed-PDF submissions, the footnote 3 requirement applies to that submission.

citations.quote: Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.

children.distinction: This child formalizes the channel and method alternatives while leaving the certificate relationship as a separate authority question.

facts.meaning: The event was submitted through STREAMS 2.
facts.name: submitted_via_streams2

facts.meaning: The event uploaded a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format.
facts.name: method_prescribed_pdf

facts.meaning: The event completed the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
facts.name: method_web_form

questions: Was this an actual STR submission to the JFIU, and which channel and method did this particular event use?
For a PDF event, which prescribed form applied, was it completed, and was that completed form uploaded?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] The selected event satisfies the listed-method condition when it was submitted through STREAMS 2 and used XML, prescribed-PDF upload, or the web-based form.
children.subject: STREAMS 2 channel and listed submission method

assumptions: The footnote applies to XML and prescribed-PDF submissions as marked in the circular.
No certificate-holder, signing, authentication, attachment, or validity condition is inferred without further authority.

citations.quote: Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.

children.distinction: The source states that an e-Cert is required for the marked submission but does not specify the operational relation that makes the requirement satisfied.
questions: What operational relationship between a Hongkong Post e-Cert and an XML or PDF submission satisfies footnote 3?
Do the applicable technical requirements impose certificate-holder, authorization or validity conditions, and if so, what are they?
What evidence establishes that relationship for this event?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] The XML or prescribed-PDF branch cannot receive a complete compliance determination until authoritative information specifies how the required Hongkong Post e-Cert must be supplied or used. Certificate availability alone and any undefined satisfaction predicate are insufficient.
children.subject: Submission-specific Hongkong Post e-Cert requirement

assumptions: The blackout urgent-contact instruction is a separate event classification from a STREAMS 2 submission.
The retained text supplies no resubmission deadline.

citations.quote: for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;
For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.

children.distinction: This child preserves the blackout contact exception and post-implementation resubmission obligation without merging them into the original submission event.
questions: If the STR required urgent submission during the blackout, what direct contact with the JFIU occurred through a listed method?
Does the same STR have any post-implementation submission outside STREAMS 2, and what subsequent resubmission and JFIU guidance are evidenced?
children.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] Blackout direct contact and any later resubmission are assessed as separate obligations; neither changes the original event's channel, method, or timestamp.
children.subject: Blackout urgent contact and separate resubmission obligation

obligations.explanation: The parent meaning is decomposed into scope/effective-date, method, unresolved e-Cert, and separate transitional-event components. The e-Cert child remains unresolved, so the parent cannot be settled by partial children.

value.parent_relation: Children refine the parent into independently assessable prerequisites and preserve the unresolved certificate dependency; no child alone settles the parent.
residual_questions: What authoritative source defines the operational e-Cert relationship for XML and prescribed-PDF submissions?
What event-specific evidence establishes scope, timestamp, method, form completion/upload, and any separate blackout contact or resubmission?
